mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (order_no, user_id, passenger_id, train_no, instance_no, travel_date, seat_no, from_seq, to_seq, amount, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{passengerId}, #{trainNo}, #{instanceNo}, #{travelDate}, #{seatNo}, #{fromSeq}, #{toSeq}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, passenger_id, train_no, instance_no, travel_date, seat_no, from_seq, to_seq, amount, status, create_time, update_time FROM `order` WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, passenger_id, train_no, instance_no, travel_date, seat_no, from_seq, to_seq, amount, status, create_time, update_time FROM `order` WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, passenger_id, train_no, instance_no, travel_date, seat_no, from_seq, to_seq, amount, status, create_time, update_time FROM `order` WHERE status = '已确认' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, create_time, NOW()) > #{timeoutSeconds} ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
